errors.text: The hypothesis relocates the key antiferromagnetic interaction to an interphase exchange between Ti in C14 and Fe/Co/Ni in FCC, whereas the target mechanism concerns antiparallel Ti and Fe/Co/Ni sublattice contributions, including within the FCC electronic structure.

It assumes that the C14 phase remains magnetically ordered or supplies magnetic anisotropy at 400 K, despite the phase-specific C14 transitions occurring near 214–246 K; thus, direct C14 magnetic order cannot straightforwardly explain the 400 K coercivity.
